text: XXX. 1. Nava yime bhikkhave āghātapaṭivinayā. Katame nava? 2. ‘Anatthaṃ me acari, taṃ kut'; ettha labbhā'; ti āghātaṃ paṭivineti, ‘anatthaṃ me carati, taṃ kut'; ettha labbhā'; ti āghātaṃ paṭivineti, ‘anatthaṃ me carissati, taṃ kut'; ettha labbhā'; ti āghātaṃ paṭivineti, ‘piyassa me manāpassa anatthaṃ acari . . .anatthaṃ carati . . . anatthaṃ carissati, [page 409] XXXI. 1-2 Sattāvāsa-Vagga. 409 [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] taṃ kut'; ettha labbhā'; ti āghātaṃ paṭivineti, ‘appiyassa me amanāpassa atthaṃ cari . . . atthaṃ carati . . .atthaṃ carissati, taṃ kut'; ettha labbhā'; ti āghātaṃ paṭivineti. Ime kho bhikkhave nava āghātapaṭivinayā ti.
